---
applyTo: "**/*.tf"
---

# Terraform Instructions for ECP AVD

## File Structure

Organize Terraform modules with this structure:

```
src/level{N}/{area}/{unit}/
├── main.tf              # Resource group and primary resources
├── {resource}.tf        # Resource-specific files
├── variables.tf         # Input variables
├── outputs.tf           # Output values
└── resource_name_data.tf # Azure CAF naming data sources
```

## File Header Format

Start every `.tf` file with this header:

```hcl
# ============================================================================
# Enterprise Cloud Platform (ECP) - Terraform Configuration
# ============================================================================
# Module:       {Module Name}
# Type:         {File Type}
# Repository:   enterprise-cloud-platform-wp-avd
# ============================================================================
```

## ECP Framework Variables

Always include these variables in `variables.tf`:

```hcl
variable "azure_location" {
  type = string
}

variable "azure_resource_name_elements" {
  type = object({
    prefixes      = optional(list(string))
    suffixes      = optional(list(string))
    name          = optional(string)
    random_length = optional(number)
  })
  description = "Object containing naming components for azurecaf_name data source."
}

variable "azure_tags" {
  type    = map(string)
  default = {}
}
```

## Azure CAF Naming Pattern

Use the Azure CAF naming provider for all resources:

```hcl
data "azurecaf_name" "rg" {
  name          = try(var.azure_resource_name_elements.name, null)
  resource_type = "azurerm_resource_group"
  prefixes      = try(var.azure_resource_name_elements.prefixes, [])
  suffixes      = try(var.azure_resource_name_elements.suffixes, [])
  random_length = try(var.azure_resource_name_elements.random_length, 0)
  clean_input   = true
  use_slug      = true
}
```

## Code Style

1. **Variable Organization:** ECP framework variables first, then module-specific
2. **Use `try()` Function:** For optional object properties to avoid null errors
3. **Descriptive Names:** Clear, descriptive resource and variable names
4. **Consistent Tagging:** Always pass `azure_tags` to resources that support tags
5. **Comments:** Only for complex logic, not obvious code
6. **File Separation:** Split resources into logical files by resource type

## Resource Naming

Reference the CAF naming data source for resource names:

```hcl
resource "azurerm_resource_group" "main" {
  name     = data.azurecaf_name.rg.result
  location = var.azure_location
  tags     = var.azure_tags
}
```

## Provider Requirements

Provider configuration is auto-generated by Terragrunt. Do not create `providers.tf` manually in modules.

Required provider versions:
- `hashicorp/azurerm ~> 4.14.0`
- `aztfmod/azurecaf` (latest)

## Outputs

Define outputs for values needed by other modules:

```hcl
output "resource_group_name" {
  value       = azurerm_resource_group.main.name
  description = "The name of the resource group."
}

output "resource_group_id" {
  value       = azurerm_resource_group.main.id
  description = "The ID of the resource group."
}
```
